thread:
incident-bot: Pager: continuous-batch latency + error spike in prod us-east-1. Metric alerts: cont_batch_queue_time p95 > 500ms, request_error_rate increased from 2% -> 12%. Ticket INC-7832.

sam (oncall): ack — I'm on it, pulling logs.

maya (runtime): I see KV cache size jump ~6x around 18:04 UTC, and microbatch sizes jumping to 32 (normal ~8).

jamal (eng-infra): no infra deploys in last 30m. any config rollouts?

priya (observability): customer impact visible: payment-processor-prod p95 2.7s, chat-prod error rate ~12%. Dash: <https://console.redwood/incidents/INC-7832>.

sam: quick triage hypothesis — continuous batching + KV eviction jitter -> batch pile-up -> microbatch growth -> backpressure -> tail latency. Mitigation plan: 1) cap max_microbatch_size to 12 2) enable batch_jitter_smoothing 3) temporary routing fallback for heavy tenants.

maya: can push runtime config to prod. proposed patch:

```yaml
continuous_batch:
  max_microbatch_size: 12
  batch_jitter_smoothing: true
  queue_timeout_ms: 80
```

sam: do it. deploy-bot will need approval.

deploy-bot: @sam Please approve config patch to runtime-configs/prod/continuous-batch (change set 94f3). Reply `approve` to proceed.

sam: approve

deploy-bot: Rolling config to 120 nodes in us-east-1 — strategy: 20% canary -> 100% in 5m. Track: <https://deploys.redwood/changes/94f3>.

maya: canary looks good on first 24 nodes. queue_time p95 dropped 700ms -> 110ms. KV cache growth subsiding.

jamal: one host gpu-3d-117 still noisy: repeated GC and `kv_cache.evicted_count` spikes ~2.1M. I'll cordon & drain that node.

li (sre): cordoned gpu-3d-117, starting drain. will replace if remains flappy.

tasha (cust-success): heads-up for CS: payment-processor opened a ticket, need an update to customer in 10m. cc @cust-success.

sam: customer impact quick note for CS:
- scope: ~7% of requests in us-east-1 (18:04–18:14 UTC) experienced elevated latency/errors
- current mitigation: runtime config cap + jitter smoothing rolled to prod; drained noisy host; routing fallback for payment-processor
- next: postmortem + tenant-level KV metrics + repro loadtest

priya: enabling temporary routing rule for payment-processor-prod -> model-legacy (fallback).

jamal: fallback routing applied (flag rollout r-502). monitoring.

maya: after full roll, p95 queue_time steady ~95–120ms, errors back to baseline. continuing 15m watch.

sam: leaving handoff notes — Li will take over in 12m. next steps for oncall: gather KV metrics per tenant for 2h window, collect config change history, attempt repro with scaled loadtest.

li: taking handoff in 12m. if anything spikes page sam/maya/jamal. I'll also run heap dump on drained host and upload to S3.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 18:11 UTC, change set 94f3. no rollback.

sam: thanks all. logging incident INC-7832 and opening postmortem doc. owners: kv-metrics (maya), loadtest-repro (jamal), customer-comms (tasha). updating incident.

incident-bot: INC-7832 status -> Mitigated at 18:12 UTC by sam.

tasha: CS update posted to payment-processor ticket: "We mitigated a high-latency issue in us-east-1; team investigating root cause, will update in 2h." :thumbsup:

li: handoff complete. last check p95 queue_time 105ms, drained host CPU stable at 39% after restart.

(End of thread)
